title: Keep option-like paths literal in sparse materialization commands
body:
An omitted directory named `--no-cone` currently produces `git sparse-checkout add --no-cone`, which treats the directory as an option. Insert the standard `--` argument boundary before generated paths/patterns. Update the existing command-shape assertion.

Validation: all 16 sparse-baseline tests pass. Two new tests pass normally and under `-O`; real Git fixtures materialize `--no-cone`, `--stdin` and `-q` directories while preserving cone mode and leaving other directories omitted. Existing non-cone and large-inventory materialization tests pass. `git diff --check` passes.

Fresh main, priorities, live PR paths and Discussion activity checked; no active PR touches this script. The selected inputs and scientific baseline are unchanged. Hosted CI is pending.

Base: `df0137efd35e11b4445734bf612bdd4c7ebc330c`. Verified head: `0740911040bf30ab00a28c5ab38734aeb4f855bc`.
